name: upstream-pack-workflow-drift
title: PARKED: upstream pack drift — stale finish-work placeholder guidance and shared review round budget
description: Two defects observed while shipping 07-25-audit-workflow-entrypoint-routing (PR #211), both in vendored pack files: sd-finish-work's fallback guidance names add_session.py placeholders that no longer exist, and sd-ship Stage 2b's mandated successor-head re-entry spends the same sd-review round budget, so an ordinary chain needs an over-limit round for bookkeeping rebuttals.
